summary: New manager can't access Admin Console after Okta promotion; SSO session invalidated intermittently
description:
Issue summary:
- New hire (promoted to manager) cannot reach Admin Console after Okta group promotion. User sees SSO redirect loop or 'session invalid' page intermittently. Works for some engineering managers but not others.

Impact:
- One engineering manager unable to access admin tools (user management, billing view) during ramp. Potential operational risk if more promotions fail. No customer-facing outage, internal productivity impact.

Environment:
- Prod (us-east) using Okta OIDC SSO integrated with Redwood Console. Affected user session created via browser (Chrome Mac). Okta groups are used to map to console RBAC roles.

Steps to reproduce (reported by user):
1) Engineer added to Okta group 'eng-managers' by People Ops.
2) User clicks 'Open Admin Console' link or navigates to console.redwood.ai.
3) Okta redirects to Redwood SSO callback.
4) Console returns 'Session invalid' or redirects to login again (sometimes works after several retries).

Observed logs / error snippets (extracted):
- auth-service: "WARN session: token mismatch for user s.patel@redwood.ai; expected session_id=abc123 got=none"
- okta-logs: "200 OK /authorize -> /callback; user_groups updated: [eng, infra] (delay=4s)"
- browser console: "Failed to set cookie: SameSite attribute mismatch"

Investigation notes so far:
- Confirmed user appears in Okta group within 30s of promotion, but the group attribute in the ID token appears inconsistent on first callback (sometimes missing).
- Token introspection shows correct groups when requested manually, but the initial OIDC response occasionally omits groups due to Okta provisioning delay.
- Auth service expects groups present in ID token to assign RBAC on session creation. If groups missing, user gets base role and console denies admin routes.
- Repeating login within ~20s usually resolves because Okta includes groups on later callbacks; suggests a timing/race between People Ops add and Okta group propagation to token.
- Not a browser-specific bug (reproduced in Firefox).

Workaround for customer (manual):
- Re-run SSO sign-in after 30s-60s; user then receives correct role and access.
- Support can trigger a forced session re-issue via internal admin tool (path: /internal/sessions/refresh) for immediate fix.

Immediate actions taken:
- Reproduced locally with a test user and measured a ~2-6s window where groups are missing in ID token immediately after group add.
- Opened a ticket with People Ops to stagger promotions during business hours and notify support for immediate re-sign-in assistance.
- Added temporary logging in auth-service to capture ID token 'groups' payload at debug level for the next 48h.

Proposed permanent fixes / follow-ups:
1) Change RBAC flow to fetch groups from a backend userinfo API / Okta introspection on first login if groups missing from token (fall back to group API) to avoid being dependent on token propagation timing.
2) Implement short-lived recheck/retry in our SSO callback (2 retries, 3s apart) when groups absent before creating a session.
3) Document People Ops on best practices and add a small delay or notification after group-only changes for sensitive roles.
4) Add a monitoring alert for repeated 'missing-groups-in-token' occurrences (>5/hour).

Links / references:
- Slack thread: #internal-support (https://slack.redwood.ai/archives/C08ABC123)
- Confluence RBAC runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=12345678-RBAC-Runbook
- Repro infra PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1824
